mapper.select: select confirmation_id, package_id, employee_id, final_document_version, document_root_hash, confirmation_text, identity_method, request_id, ip_address, user_agent, confirmed_time from oa_sign_final_confirmation where request_id = #{requestId} limit 1

select confirmation_id, package_id, employee_id, final_document_version, document_root_hash, confirmation_text, identity_method, request_id, ip_address, user_agent, confirmed_time from oa_sign_final_confirmation where package_id = #{packageId} and final_document_version = #{finalDocumentVersion} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into oa_sign_final_confirmation ( package_id, employee_id, final_document_version, document_root_hash, confirmation_text, identity_method, request_id, ip_address, user_agent, confirmed_time, create_time ) values ( #{packageId}, #{employeeId}, #{finalDocumentVersion}, #{documentRootHash}, #{confirmationText}, #{identityMethod}, #{requestId}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{confirmedTime}, sysdate() )

insert into oa_sign_final_confirmation_document ( confirmation_id, package_id, document_id, final_document_version, final_pdf_hash, create_time ) values ( #{confirmationId}, #{packageId}, #{documentId}, #{finalDocumentVersion}, #{finalPdfHash}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select count(*) from oa_sign_final_confirmation where package_id = #{packageId}
